## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Note any tool, configuration, migration, or compatibility changes.

## Validation

List exact commands and results. For a behavior change or fix, include the observed failing regression test; for a behavior-preserving change, identify existing characterization coverage. Documentation-only changes do not need an artificial failing test.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within its intended scope and affected docs are updated.
- [ ] Relevant checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md` passed, or unrun checks and reasons are listed.
- [ ] No real credentials, local environment files, database volumes, telemetry exports, or private paths are included.
- [ ] Security and persistence boundaries remain covered where affected; existing migrations were not rewritten.

Report exploitable vulnerabilities privately according to `SECURITY.md`. Use synthetic data in examples, logs, and reproductions.
